answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock a refundable stake before trading, slashed if peers prove fraud. Like light through a prism, one stake is checked by independent validators, so one operator cannot cheaply mint many trusted personas. Reputation grows only from completed auditable work, like a lotus opening slowly, while umber-marked audit trails expose cloned histories. Forging thousands of agents would need thousands of stakes and work records, costing more than honest participation.
